data.short_meaning: God of Gods, Lord of Lords
data.long_meaning: Devmanansh is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning God and ‘Manas’ meaning mind or intellect. This name signifies the God of Gods or the Lord of Lords, who is the supreme being and the ruler of all minds and intellects. The name Devmanansh carries the meaning “God of Gods, Lord of Lords” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Devmanansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods, lord of lords and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devmanansh is a powerful and spiritual name that represents the divine presence within an individual. It signifies the connection between the individual and the supreme being, and the influence of the divine on the individual's thoughts, actions, and emotions.
data.etymology: Devmanansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Gods, Lord of Lords.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devmanansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Devmanansh' is derived from 'Deva' meaning god and 'Manansh' meaning intellect or thought. It is believed that this name emerged during the medieval period when Hindu philosophers and scholars were deeply engaged in the study and contemplation of divine knowledge and scriptures.

Another reference to the name 'Devmanansh' can be found in the Puranic literature, specifically the Skanda Purana. In this text, 'Devmanansh' is described as a divine being who was born to help Lord Shiva in his battle against the demon Tripurasura. He is also known as 'Skanda' or 'Kartikeya' and is revered as the god of war and knowledge.
